text:
Meera (Marketplace PM): Quick sync on AtlasCloud marketplace onboarding for europe-central-2. Goal: list by Apr 15, capacity + quotas locked, and a joint announcement draft ready. Need confirmation on quotas, entitlement timeline, and any compliance signoffs. Can partners confirm capacity targets by EOD Fri?
Ana (Partnerships): @Sven can you confirm AtlasCloud's quota window and any marketplace entitlements we need to request? we have to align marketplace SKU IDs with your catalog. :calendar:
Sven (AtlasCloud PM): working on it. capacity-wise we can offer an initial soft quota of 40 cards (NVIDIA A10G equiv) and scale to 120 after validation. I need the exact SKU mapping from Redwood to match billing.
Meera (Marketplace PM): thanks. SKU mapping is our side but we need AtlasCloud to accept the entitlements flow. I'll drop the expected SKU list in a follow-up. Also, is there any limitation on reserved instances in europe-central-2 we should know?
Liam (CloudOps): quick note: networking egress through the partner NAT has an advertised burst limit of 8Gbps per AZ. If your workload needs more, we need to pre-approve cross-AZ routing.
Sven (AtlasCloud PM): noted. 8Gbps per AZ should be fine for initial customers. We can provision extra egress on request (takes ~48h).
Ana (Partnerships): timeline check: Redwood needs marketplace entitlement approved by partner console + partner contract addendum signed. @Rachel do we have the contract addendum template finalized?
Rachel (Legal): yes, the addendum v2 is ready — minor updates to data residency clauses for eu-central. I'll attach it to the partner workspace. Please route any redlines ASAP.
Meera (Marketplace PM): to make engineering work predictable: can CloudOps provide a minimal gating checklist so we don't hit last-minute blockers? e.g., quota ticket, NAT egress approval, marketplace SKU mapping, KMS key provisioning.
Liam (CloudOps): creating a short checklist now. posting in thread:
```
Gating checklist for new-region onboarding (eu-central-2):
1) Partner entitlement created in partner console (partner: AtlasCloud)
2) SKU mapping file uploaded to /marketplace/schemas
3) Quota ticket opened with infra (include expected sustained GPUs)
4) Networking: NAT egress pre-approval (ops ticket)
5) KMS key creation + IAM roles for marketplace pull
6) Compliance: legal addendum signed
7) Smoke test plan and tracing hooks enabled
```
Sven (AtlasCloud PM): that helps a lot. On the entitlement side I'm waiting on SKU list and the addendum. I'll spin up a preliminary pool for the smoke tests — ETA Wed.
Infra-bot: Ticket #MID-8742 created: "eu-central-2 marketplace quota request (AtlasCloud)" assigned to CloudOps. Link: https://redwood.atlassian/ MID-8742
Meera (Marketplace PM): perfect. two operational asks for partners: 1) confirm the SKUs by tomorrow noon, 2) confirm announcement embargo window (we're aiming Apr 20 public). If either slips we'll push the announcement.
Sven (AtlasCloud PM): SKUs by tomorrow noon is aggressive but doable, leaning on my infra lead to collate. embargo Apr 20 accepted for now.
Ana (Partnerships): coordinating comms with marketing — will block Apr 18 for final PR review.
Rachel (Legal): I'll aim to return redlines within 48h upon receipt. If there are data residency exceptions we'll escalate.
Meera (Marketplace PM): small nit: can CloudOps add a short sample smoke-test command we can run against the partner pool so product orgs can validate quickly?
Liam (CloudOps): yes — sample test below (will share in repo):
```
# quick smoke run (dockerized test agent)
REDWOOD_REGION=europe-central-2 \
PARTNER_POOL=atlas-eu-central-2 \
./scripts/smoke-run.sh --model small --tokens 64
```
Meera (Marketplace PM): lovely. I'll create a companion PR with the SKU list and the announcement draft once we have AtlasCloud's confirmation. Thanks all — if anyone hits a blocker ping me directly. :thumbsup:
Sven (AtlasCloud PM): will do. thanks team.
Ana (Partnerships): moving to checklist board. :rocket:
